device.type: 4K UHD DVB-S2X + DVB-T2/C H.265/HEVC combo receiver with Conax CA card reader and USB Wi-Fi
device.board: 7C000A00 (bootloader version "M2662A 1.0.1", 8 MB SPI flash, ALi M2662A / C3922 ARMv7-A platform)
device.soc: ALi M2662A / C3922 (ARMv7-A CPU, DECV_HEVC_0, NIM_C3501h_0)
device.family: M3801 (chips/m3801.py, NCRC chunk container only; CPU is ARMv7-A rather than MIPS32)

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Unpacked from AMIKO_Mini_4K_Combo_1.0.21_emu.zip in the Amiko/Amiko Mini 4K UHD Combo folder.

simulator.note: Does not boot on the MIPS32 simulator (run_dump_amiko_mini_4k_arm_layout.py): the 8 MB image uses ALi's standard NCRC chunk container (magic 0x23010010 at 0x000000, HEAD descriptor at 0x250, LZMA-compressed maincode(AV) at 0x078000 decompressing to 15.84 MB), but the ALi M2662A / C3922 is an ARMv7-A 4K combo SoC with an ARM exception vector table at 0x800 and CP15 SCTLR access at 0x820.

desc: Amiko Mini 4K UHD Combo firmware v1.0.21 EMU (2020-09-08) for the 4K Ultra HD H.265/HEVC combo receiver based on the ALi M2662A / C3922 ARMv7-A platform with 8 MB SPI flash.
Demonstrates ALi's 4K SoC architecture, packaging ARMv7-A binaries inside the standard ALi NCRC chunk layout alongside LZMA-compressed TDS maincode.
